episodes.title: Three Doctors
episodes.plot: Joel succumbs to a strange glacier-related illness, leaving healer Leonard to handle patients including sleep-flying Ed and a suddenly songless Shelly.

episodes.title: The Mystery of the Old Curio Shop
episodes.plot: Maggie falls into a mystery surrounding an antique shop, Maurice resists aging with characteristic force, and Joel discovers an unexpected link between Jewish and Native traditions.

episodes.title: Jaws of Life
episodes.plot: Maurice is immortalized in wax, Chris learns he may live far longer than expected, and the arrival of a dentist makes Cicely rethink a neglected necessity.

episodes.title: Altered Egos
episodes.plot: Bernard's girlfriend cannot reliably tell him from Chris, forcing the half-brothers to confront the uncanny overlap in their identities and relationships.

episodes.title: A River Doesn't Run Through It
episodes.plot: A teenager asks Maggie to be homecoming queen, an uncompromising tax agent audits Ruth-Anne, and Maurice negotiates a land deal across cultural lines.

episodes.title: Birds of a Feather
episodes.plot: Joel's parents visit Cicely, where his mother embraces Alaska and his father becomes unexpectedly popular, leaving Joel feeling displaced in his own family.

episodes.title: Rosebud
episodes.plot: Ed organizes Cicely's first film festival while Leonard searches American popular culture for evidence of a shared white mythology.

episodes.title: Heal Thyself
episodes.plot: Ed's successful diagnosis brings romance and a crisis of confidence, while Holling's mockery of pregnancy gets him expelled from Shelly's childbirth class.

episodes.title: A Cup of Joe
episodes.plot: A grisly local story about cannibalism disturbs Ed, Holling and Ruth-Anne, while Chris's attempt to qualify as a pilot becomes its own test of nerves.

episodes.title: First Snow
episodes.plot: As Cicely waits for winter's first snow, Joel struggles with an elderly patient's certainty that death is near and Shelly fears a small lie has physical consequences.

episodes.title: Baby Blues
episodes.plot: Maggie organizes Shelly's baby shower, a Hollywood agent takes interest in Ed's screenplay, and Chris experiments with his idea of an inner feminine self.

episodes.title: Mr. Sandman
episodes.plot: The aurora causes residents to exchange dreams, pushing Holling toward therapy and intensifying the feud between Maurice and innkeepers Ron and Erick.

episodes.title: Mite Makes Right
episodes.plot: A virtuoso violinist begs Maurice to let a priceless instrument be played, Maggie becomes terrified of dust mites, and Chris hits an artistic wall.

episodes.title: A Bolt from the Blue
episodes.plot: Maurice's fireworks crew alarms conspiracy-minded Adam, a displaced ranger refuses to leave his post, and Ed survives being struck by lightning.

episodes.title: Hello, I Love You
episodes.plot: Shelly reconsiders giving birth in Anchorage, Walt risks frostbite for Ruth-Anne, and Joel discovers he is annoyingly good at Marilyn's knitting workshop.

episodes.title: Northern Hospitality
episodes.plot: Joel's first dinner party becomes a social disaster, Shelly reconnects with her Canadian identity, and Chris's new radio programming irritates his loyal listeners.

episodes.title: Una Volta in L'Inverno
episodes.plot: Cabin fever and rampaging caribou hit Cicely as Joel and Maggie are snowbound together, Walt misuses seasonal-depression medication and Ruth-Anne studies Dante in Italian.

episodes.title: Fish Story
episodes.plot: Joel becomes obsessed with catching an enormous fish, while Ruth-Anne abruptly abandons routine and takes to the road on a motorcycle.

episodes.title: The Gift of the Maggie
episodes.plot: Joel bonds with another physician, Maurice temporarily moves in with the Tambo-Vincoeurs after an explosion, and Chris becomes fascinated by a chain of deer-related coincidences.

episodes.title: A Wing and a Prayer
episodes.plot: Shelly's faith falters before Miranda's baptism, while Ed seeks redemption after carelessly spreading private details about Ruth-Anne.

episodes.title: I Feel the Earth Move
episodes.plot: Ron and Erick prepare to marry despite Maurice's outrage, while Maggie develops a strange physical reaction whenever she is near Joel.

episodes.title: Grand Prix
episodes.plot: Wheelchair racers arrive for a major competition, Ed's old embodiment of low self-esteem returns, and Ted gets an uncomfortable lesson in wealth and class.

episodes.title: Blood Ties
episodes.plot: Cicely's blood drive reveals someone who may share Ed's rare blood type, while the return of Maggie's former boyfriend threatens Joel's growing closeness with her.

episodes.title: Lovers and Madmen
episodes.plot: Cal leaves the asylum temporarily to help Maurice entertain Barbara, Chris discovers memory has idealized an old love, and Joel finds a frozen mammoth.
